panels.description: A Halyard worker inserts a repaired component into a public registry kiosk. Keep the component and kiosk clear, with upper space for lettering.
The registry records Caldera House ownership, an unlisted creator and a 14-credit bonus. Keep the display unobstructed.
Alex scans his identity band at an adjacent reader while Ada watches from the edge. Leave upper registry space.
Adrian's estate record fills the public display, with Alex reflected faintly in the glass. Keep the text area clear.
